operative_clauses.original_operative_text:
Section  101. (a ) There is hereby established the interdepartmental 
Committee on the Status o f Women (hereinafter referred to as the 
“ Committee” ), which shall be composed o f the Secretary o f Labor, 
who shall be the Chairman o f the Committee, the Secretary o f State, 
the Secretary o f Defense, the Attorney General, the Secretary of 
Agriculture, the Secretary o f Commerce, the Secretary o f Health, 
Education, and W elfare, and the Chairman of the Civil Service Com­
mission, all ex officio. The Director o f the Women’s Bureau o f the 
Department o f Labor shall serve as Executive Vice-Chairman o f the 
Committee, and shall be an ex officio member thereof.

S e c. 201. There is hereby established the Citizens’ Advisory Coun­
cil on the Status of Women (hereinafter referred to as the “ Council” ) , 
which shall be composed o f 17 members appointed by the President, 
one o f whom he shall designate to serve as Chairman. The council 
shall meet at the call o f the Chairman o f the Committee, but not less 
than twice a year. Members o f the Council shall serve without com­
pensation from the United States.

seeded_payload.research_rationale: EO 11126 (November 1, 1963; 28 FR 11717-11718, read in the held govinfo scan) set up an Interdepartmental Committee on the Status of Women of cabinet officers (Part I) and a Citizens' Advisory Council on the Status of Women (Part II), with support provisions (Part III). It has no term of its own. Clause-level history: EO 12050 (Apr. 4, 1978) substituted new texts for secs. 101(a), 103 and 201, so the original texts ended then. The Council was an advisory committee in existence on January 5, 1973 and would have expired under sec. 14(a)(1) of the Federal Advisory Committee Act on January 5, 1975, but EO 11827 (signed January 4, 1975) continued it to January 5, 1977 and EO 11948 (effective December 31, 1976) to December 31, 1978, so there was no statutory lapse. EO 12007 (August 22, 1977) terminated the Council and revoked sec. 102(5) and Part II and rewrote sec. 103 and the second sentence of sec. 301, so those clauses ended then. The Committee clauses (federal officials, outside the Act) continued until EO 12050 sec. 8 revoked EO 11126 as amended, signed April 4, 1978 with no other effective date stated: that is the whole-order end. None of these orders contains a savings clause.

savings_residuals.reason: EO 12050 sec. 8 revokes EO 11126 'as amended' with no savings, transition or winding-up clause, and EO 12007 had already terminated the Citizens' Advisory Council without one. EO 11126 created advisory and coordinating bodies only: no right, benefit, office or obligation of a person depended on it. The National Advisory Committee for Women and the Interdepartmental Task Force that EO 12050 created rest on EO 12050 itself (policy continuity, not a survival of EO 11126).
